verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents dynamic variables or injecting per-caller context when a call starts. The only route shown is indirect: a custom function can call your own API mid-call with configurable URL, headers, parameters and responses, which could pull caller-specific data into the conversation. Separately, contacts with fields exist, but their link to conversation personalization is unshown. Missing for 10: documented dynamic-variable templating in prompts, call-time injection of per-caller context via API/SDK when creating or receiving calls, inbound-call context lookup, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
